React version: 19.2.7 react-refresh version: 0.18.0 ## Steps To Reproduce Link to code example: https://stackblitz.com/edit/react-refresh-function-name-issue?file=src%2Findex.tsx ```tsx import { createContext, type Provider, useContext } from 'react'; import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client'; const moContextValueSymbol = Symbol('no-context-value'); function createRequiredContext() { return ( name: string extends Name ? never : Name ): { [K in `${Name}Provider`]: Provider; } & { [K in `use${Name}`]: () => T; } => { const providerName = `${name as Name}Provider` as const; const hookName = `use${name as Name}` as const; const Context = createContext( moContextValueSymbol ); Context.displayName = `${name}Context`; return { [providerName]: Context.Provider as Provider, [hookName]: () => { const value = useContext(Context); if (value === moContextValueSymbol) { throw new Error(`No ${Context.displayName} value was provided`); } return value; }, } as any; }; } const { ReactExampleProvider, useReactExample } = createRequiredContext()('ReactExample'); const hookName = 'useVanillaExample'; const { useVanillaExample } = { [hookName]: () => {} }; const Parent = () => ( ); const Child = () => `Context value: ${useReactExample()}`; createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render( 
    {}
    {'\n\n'}
    useReactExample.name === "{useReactExample.name}"{'\n'}
    useVanillaExample.name === "{useVanillaExample.name}"
); ``` ## The current behavior `useReactExample.name` is the empty string. When inspecting the `Child` instance in dev tools, you see a cryptic `tsx/createRequiredContext/{ var _s = $RefreshSig$(); const providerName = `${name}Provider`; const hookName = `use${name}`; const Context = /*#__PURE__*/ (0,react__rspack_import_1.createContext)(moContextValueSymbol); Context.displayName = `${name}Context`; return { [providerName]: Context.Provider, [hookName]: _s(()=>{ _s(); const value = (0,react__rspack_import_1.useContext)(Context); if (value === moContextValueSymbol) { throw new Error(`No ${Context.displayName} value was provided`); } return value; }, "ksutO2/Ix3UeCrGnhyM+QEP505Y=") }; }; } ```
